links.comparator_used: Original NYC-derived model coefficients applied as-is to South Carolina and Florida births, without local recalibration or re-estimation
links.outcome: Calibration and discrimination of the 30-day postpartum hospital use prediction model in new states
links.effect: Original coefficients: AUC 0.68 (95% CI 0.67-0.68) in SC and 0.69 (95% CI 0.68-0.69) in FL, with overestimated and extreme risk predictions. Intercept updating corrected calibration. Re-estimating coefficients gave AUC 0.69 (0.68-0.69) in SC and 0.70 (0.70-0.71) in FL. AUC also increased within Black, Medicaid-insured, and rural subgroups.
links.quote: Updating model intercepts corrected calibration, and additionally re-estimating coefficients resulted in an AUC of 0.69 (95% CI 0.68-0.69) in SC and 0.70 (95% CI 0.70-0.71) in FL.
